annotations.title: Find a community to belong to, or Christian life at a university

description: PURPOSE: Find ongoing Christian community to belong to: discoverable groups on The Living Bread (prayer groups, study groups, city and interest communities) with member counts, how to join and the next posted gathering; or the house's University Network page for a country, US state or city. WHEN TO USE: "is there a prayer group", "a Bible study community in Atlanta", "Christian community at universities in Kenya". WHEN NOT: church buildings: find_churches. One-off events: find_gatherings. A person to pray with now: find_people_to_pray_with. MODES (required parameters in brackets): to_join [none] communities, filtered by query words matched against name, description, kind, city and country (any word matches, so more words widen), paged with limit (1 to 20, default 10) and cursor. university [place] one country, US state or city. OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: to_join gives count, total, communities [{id, name, kind, description, where, people, join, next_gathering, verified, freshness}], join_here and next_cursor; university gives matched (null when not held), title, url, summary, entries (up to 14 campus or region pages), suggestions and door. BEHAVIOR: read only. to_join reads live data and never lists private family rooms; university fetches living-bread.org at call time and returns page links, not a structured list of student groups. No match returns count 0, or matched null with the places held. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

cursor.description: Opaque paging token: next_cursor from the previous answer of the same call. Omit for the first page.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: to_join, university. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

place.description: For university: one country, US state or city by name: "Japan", "California", "Nairobi".

query.description: For to_join: filter words, e.g. "prayer", "study", "Atlanta". Omit to list all.

name: find_communities

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Find a community to belong to, or Christian life at a university
